title: Order of Definite Adjectives
theory:
1 Cardinal - Cardinal numbers show quantity (how many) (fdrusfxurh).
 Ex. — one, two, three, four
 2 Ordinal - Ordinal numbers show position or order (LFkku ;k ozQe).
 Ex. — first, second, third, fourth.
 3 Ordinal Number comes FIRST
 4 Cardinal Number comes AFTER.
 Structure: Ordinal Number + Cardinal Number + Noun
